attributes.board_name: New Mexico Speech-Language Pathology, Audiology and Hearing Aid Dispensing Practices Board (Regulation and Licensing Department)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Education activities sponsored or approved by a national or state professional association of speech-language pathologists, audiologists or hearing aid dispensers; other programs need prior board-office approval. Hours must be in the field of licensure, or a related field if justified to the board office.
rules.new_licensee_rule: If the next renewal is less than 12 months after licensure: 1 hour per month licensed, max 10 clock hours. Approved hours earned before licensure in the year of issue count.
rules.audit_note: Licensees not audited sign an affidavit on the annual renewal; the board audits a percentage of renewals each year. Keep CE documentation for at least two years.
rules.notes: Licenses renew annually, but CE is counted as 20 hours every two years; hours may be spread over the two years or earned in one year. A person licensed as both SLP and audiologist (or hearing aid dispenser) needs 20 clock hours every two years in each field. No state-mandated topics. A 2025 proposal to replace 16.26.5 NMAC was published; the compiled rule checked still shows the 2017 text.
